name: Pro
tagline: A workplace machine that stays readable.
description: The professional workplace template, tuned for GNOME rather than the MangoWM desktop, with its own ISO installer.

name: Console
tagline: Put the console where the couch is.
description: The living-room variant: a gamescope Steam Big Picture session with a controller-first settings frontend and a Millennium theme.

name: Fleet
tagline: One control plane for every endpoint.
description: The managed-fleet line, split into a controller server, a web fleet manager, and an endpoint role kept separate from the desktop template.

name: Minimal
tagline: Start with the smallest honest system.
description: The bare template and terminal installer. It installs with the standard setup script, boots to a console login, and leaves desktops and GUI tooling to the fork.

name: Home Server
tagline: A home server that stays quiet.
description: The home NAS and server variant, with a template and installer for the machine that stays on in the corner.

name: Infrastructure
tagline: Keep the servers out of the desktop.
description: The server line for automated pentesting and CI, kept apart from the desktop and home-server variants.
